ctx.x: You have a bit more relevant advice for your daughter. What would you tell her about the music business at this point?

So actually we’ve been talking about it. So my daughter is a straight A student. She is doing so well. And it’s funny, she just did a talent show and won the all-school talent show this year, a couple of days ago. And I sat there and my mom and dad and my in- laws and our whole family was there to support her. And my mom was sitting and crying so hard.
